items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Oh, Georgia Boy, he's a man who went with Pudgy all the time. He was a pretty good clarinet player, too, Georgia Boy.

ctx.x: Uh, what about this other clarinet player that, uh, we never heard, this, uh, Georgia Boy?
Oh, Georgia Boy, he's a man who went with Pudgy all the time. He was a pretty good clarinet player, too, Georgia Boy.
Did he play on the order of Pills and Zeb and those fellas? Well, yeah. He played on that order, too.
